statement: The authors report alpha-theory certification of at least one witness set attaining their observed maximum of 8 real points on SO(3). Together with degree 8 this proves total reality for SO(3).

answer.text: An example with 8 real section points was certified.

source.location: Section 7, certification paragraph and Table 3, n=3

notes:
The paper says only selected maximum witnesses were certified; its full frequency table is numerical. Certificates were not rerun.
